sentences.text:
This Petition, Coming On For Admission, This Day,
The Court Made The Following:
 Order

The petitioner herein had fled a private complaint under Section 200 of Cr.PC alleging that when he was suffering from stomachache, he had taken treatment from the respondents No.2 and 3,
however, the accused No.1 wrongly diagnosed the ailment and furnished a report that the complainant was having stones in both right and left kidneys.

The learned Magistrate took cognizance of the offence under Sections 177, 420, 464, 336, 337, 338 of IPC and Section 20(A) of Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 and Section 26 of Indian medicine Act, 1970 and issued summons to the accused.
2. Taking exception to the same, the respondents No.2 and 3 herein filed Crl.R.P No.90/2021 under Section 397 of Cr.PC.

The learned District Judge after hearing the parties, set aside the order passed by the learned Magistrate taking cognizance of the aforesaid offences, and further directed the Trial Court to refer the matter to a competent Doctor or Committee of Doctors and call for the report with regard to the alleged medical negligence, if any and thereafter to proceed in accordance with law.
Hence, this petition.

3. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, the learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent No.1 - State, the learned counsel for the respondents No.2 and 3 and 4.
4.

The learned District Judge in the impugned order by referring to the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Jacob Mathew's -vs- State of Punjab and another (2005 (6) SCC 1) has held that the Trial Court before taking cognizance of the offences should have independently formed a Committee and referred the matter to it, or a doctor specialized in the field relating to the above Siddappa S/O Shankrappa Desai vs The State Of Karnataka And Ors on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61431743/
2 aspect and only thereafter, if the Committee reported that there was prima-face case of medical negligence, should have taken cognizance of the offence and issued summons.

sentences.text: Insofar as it relates to the accused No.3, there is no allegation of negligence as against the said respondent except that he is the District Health Officer.
Hence, I do not find any illegality or infirmity in the impugned order passed by the learned District Judge.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER Criminal petition is dismissed.
In view of disposal of the petition, the interlocutory application does not survive for consideration.
